en: Vintage sepia postcard with two inset black‑and‑white views: on the left a large ornate fountain with multiple water jets and statuary in a landscaped park, captioned "Franz Josef-Brunnen." On the right, an image of a tall rectangular tower rising above trees. At the top right is printed text "Gruss aus Graz." The left margin carries the printer's credit "Stengel & Co., Dresden, 4725." There is cursive handwritten text and a date on the right side and along the bottom.
